split: largest power of two strictly less than n

implementation_limits.note: Not part of the RFC 9162 wire format. This JS implementation refuses a tree size that is not a safe integer (above 2^53-1) and a proof longer than 64 hashes.

genesis: m = 0 yields an empty proof; the old root is the empty root
equal_size: m = n yields an empty proof; the roots must be equal
